Dark-xianxia pixel art, isometric RPG, overbearing and dominant "heaven-defying" presence.

Transparent background. No UI frame. Do not draw the glow as a soft blur: paint only hard-edged pixels

NEGATIVE (forbidden):
cute, kawaii, chibi, adorable, baby, big round shiny eyes, rosy cheeks, smiling, friendly, mascot, cartoon,

anti-aliasing, painterly brush texture, drawing a copy of existing sprite.

No scenery, no full-body animal, no motif other than the one that defines the silhouette.

BACKGROUND: transparent (real alpha). If your tool cannot output alpha, use one flat solid #FF00FF magenta, with no gradient, no texture, no shadow.

LOOK (this replaces any request for a pixel grid, pixel count or color limit): chunky low-resolution pixel look, flat color clusters, simple shapes readable when shrunk.
